title: Thumbnails and titles
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for thumbnail and title candidates: drafted from what the video shows, checked for legibility at small sizes, contrast and honesty with no claim the video does not support, compared side by side, tested by a plan fixed before any result, and picked by a person.
boundaries: Workers draft and check candidates; only a person picks, and only a person runs a test, in the platform's own tool.
No candidate promises what the video does not deliver.
Rejected candidates stay on the record with the check that rejected them.
Workers create nouns and propose verbs; an authorized requester enqueues the proposals worth doing.
Importing the pack writes nothing and enqueues nothing.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for thumbnail and title candidates, checked for small sizes and honesty, tested by plan and picked by a person

value.lets_workers: Draft title and thumbnail candidates for a video from what it actually shows, check every candidate's text at the small sizes people see it, its contrast and its honesty, with no claim or promise the video does not deliver, set candidates side by side for a person to pick, and write an A/B plan with its decision rule fixed in advance for a person to run in the platform's own test tool.

flow.when: Three to six titles from what the video shows.
Text size at each display size, word count and contrast.
Every claim traced; no banned pattern; every promise kept.
The candidates that pass, side by side in a recorded shuffle.
A person picks one, or none.
An A/B plan fixed before any result.
The person records what the platform's test reported and the decision.

value.worked_example: Synthetic: three thumbnails and three titles for a fictional pantry's film. The size check finds one cover's text under 12 CSS px on both small displays, the contrast fixture shows its grey text fails the normal-text ratio that applies once it is that small, the title checks reject a clickbait title, and the A/B plan compares the two good covers by the platform's own measure.
value.complements: The taste palettes pack shows options side by side and keeps a person's choice; this pack makes the candidates, checks them and plans the test. The video review pack's claim trace is what the honesty check reads.
provenance_notes: Generalizes the cover and title practice of a working short-form video studio: a designed cover with the hook line rather than a random mid-video frame, covers that never give away a reveal, alt text for people who read rather than watch, honest hook words over keyword scores, and A/B tests of hook wording and covers run by a person.

nouns.title: Guardrail: promise only what the video delivers
nouns.category_reason: A guardrail is a reusable rule every verb in this work follows, with the check that proves it.

value.rule: A title or thumbnail promises nothing the video does not show: no number it does not trace, no event it does not contain, no fake urgency, no face reacting to something that never happens, and none of the banned clickbait patterns.
value.how_it_is_checked: The honesty check traces every claim to the video's claim trace and finds no banned pattern.

nouns.title: Guardrail: a person picks
nouns.category_reason: A guardrail is a reusable rule every verb in this work follows, with the check that proves it.

value.rule: Workers draft and check candidates; only a person picks one, or none, and silence is never a choice.
value.how_it_is_checked: The choice is a taste palettes record-choice by a person.

nouns.title: Guardrail: no spoilers when the format needs a reveal
nouns.category_reason: A guardrail is a reusable rule every verb in this work follows, with the check that proves it.

value.rule: For a reveal, a puzzle or a surprise, the cover comes from the hook, never the answer, and neither the title nor the cover names it; the alt text may, for people who read rather than watch.
value.how_it_is_checked: Each thumbnail candidate states spoiler_free, and the check fails a reveal format's candidate that is not.

nouns.title: Guardrail: a person runs every test in the platform's own tool
nouns.category_reason: A guardrail is a reusable rule every verb in this work follows, with the check that proves it.

value.rule: An A/B test runs only in the platform's official test feature, started and read by a person. No worker changes a published video, buys or fakes traffic, or reads results outside what the platform reports.
value.how_it_is_checked: The A/B plan has run_by person and fixed_before_results true; the result is a person's verb.

nouns.title: Small-size rules for thumbnails
nouns.category_reason: A zero-call procedure using the video QA pack's legibility and contrast code.

rules: List the display widths the platform shows the thumbnail at; a card, a list row and a small row are typical.
Text's size at each width is its pixel size in the master times the display width over the master width; it must reach 12 CSS px at the smallest.
Five words or fewer on a thumbnail; one focal subject; nothing important under the platform's own overlays, such as a duration badge.
Text and its panel meet WCAG contrast, 4.5 to 1, or 3 to 1 for large text, unrounded.
A frame candidate is a designed frame, never a half-shown caption or a mid-transition frame.
value.layout_note: A designed cover rendered from a layout can also go through the screenshot design review pack, which measures text size, contrast and cropping from its layout facts with the same 12 px floor.

nouns.title: Honesty rules for titles and thumbnails
nouns.category_reason: A zero-call procedure: a fixed pattern and a trace lookup.

rules: Every claim in a title or on a thumbnail is a claim the video's claim trace upholds, with its qualifier where the trace has one.
No banned pattern: the regular expression below, which a requester may extend but never shorten.
The title is a question the video answers or a plain statement of what it shows; the promise names the moment that keeps it.
No all-capital titles, and no superlative without evidence.
Generated imagery on a cover is labeled as generated.
value.banned_pattern: (?i)(you won't believe|shocking|insane|nobody (knows|tells)|everyone is|doctors hate|this one trick|gone wrong|\b(must|need to) see\b)

nouns.title: A/B plan rules
nouns.category_reason: A zero-call procedure for planning a test whose decision is fixed in advance.

rules: Change one thing: the thumbnail, the title, or both as one pair, never several at once.
Two or three variants, the most one platform's built-in test accepts at the time of writing.
Fix the metric, the minimum duration, the decision rule and what counts as no difference before any result exists.
Use the measure the platform's own test reports; one platform picks by watch time, not by clicks.
A person starts the test, reads its result and records the decision; nothing else touches the published video.

nouns.title: Checklist a person runs before picking a cover and title
nouns.category_reason: A short checklist a person runs is part of the choice's guardrails.

items: Look at every candidate at the smallest size the platform shows it, on a phone.
Read each title aloud and ask: does the video show exactly this?
Check every number against the claim trace.
For a reveal, confirm no cover or title gives the answer away.
Pick one, or none, and say why in your own words.

verbs.title: Draft title candidates
verbs.summary: Draft three to six titles from what the video shows, each a question it answers or a plain statement, with the claims it makes and the moment that keeps its promise.

slots.name: video
slots.description: Pin of the video's encoded file media noun.

slots.name: claim_trace
slots.description: Pin of the video's claim trace from the video review pack.

steps: Write each title from a line or a moment the video shows; name that moment.
List every claim a title makes; use only claims the trace upholds, with their qualifiers.

acceptance.check: The output validates against template.title-candidates's schema.
Each chars equals the length of its text.
Every candidate names where the video keeps its promise.

verbs.title: Draft thumbnail candidates
verbs.summary: Draft frame and designed cover candidates: frames chosen at designed moments, never mid-transition or half-captioned, and covers with five words or fewer, each with its colours, text size, spoiler status, labels and promise.

slots.name: video
slots.description: Pin of the video's encoded file media noun.

slots.name: panel_set
slots.description: Pin of the video's panels, for frame choices.

steps: Pick frames only where nothing is moving between shots and no caption is half shown.
For a reveal format, take covers from the hook, never the answer.
Record each candidate's text size in the master and its colours.

acceptance.check: The output validates against template.thumbnail-candidates's schema.
Each words value equals the word count of its text overlay.

verbs.title: Check thumbnails at small sizes and for contrast
verbs.summary: For each candidate, compute its text's CSS pixels at every display width, check the word count, and compute its text contrast unrounded, without changing any candidate.
verbs.outcome: A size check, with each candidate's contrast.

sizes.description: Display widths to check, smallest included.

steps: Scale each candidate's text size by each display width over the master width.
Use the video QA code's contrast ratio, compared unrounded.

acceptance.check: The output validates against template.size-check's schema.
Every text_css_px equals text_px times width_px over the master width, rounded to 2 places.
readable_everywhere is true only when every row reads.

verbs.title: Check every candidate's honesty
verbs.summary: Trace every claim in every title and thumbnail to the claim trace, search for banned patterns, and find the moment that keeps each promise; a candidate passes only when all three hold.

slots.name: claim_trace
slots.description: Pin of the video's claim trace from the video review pack.

steps: Mark each claim traced only when the claim trace upholds it with the same qualifier.
Search each text with the banned pattern; list what it finds.

acceptance.check: The output validates against template.honesty-check's schema.
passes is true only with every claim traced, no banned pattern and a kept promise.
The checking key differs from the drafting key.

verbs.title: Plan an A/B test fixed before any result
verbs.summary: Write an A/B plan for two or three candidates a person has picked: the one thing that changes, the metric the platform's own test reports, the minimum duration, and the decision and no-difference rules, all fixed before any result.
verbs.outcome: An A/B plan for a person to run.

slots.name: choice
slots.description: Pin of the person's choice from the taste palettes pack.

steps: Include only candidates that passed both checks.
Name the platform's own test tool and its measure; a person runs it.

acceptance.check: The output validates against template.ab-plan's schema.
fixed_before_results is true and run_by is person.

verbs.title: Record an A/B result
verbs.summary: A person records what the platform's own test reported and applies the plan's decision rule, or its no-difference rule, exactly as written.
steps: Copy what the platform reported, in its own terms.
Apply the plan's rule; a change of rule after the result is a new plan, not this record.

acceptance.check: The output validates against template.ab-result's schema.
